resources.string: Speed up an older TV: we will disable unnecessary preinstalled apps. Nothing is deleted, and everything can be restored with a single tap.
Follow these steps on your TV with your remote:
Click \"Build number\" 7 times until Developer options are unlocked
Enable \"USB debugging\" and \"Network debugging / Wi-Fi debugging\"
Check your TV\'s IP address in Network settings
On some TV models, \"Build number\" is inside \"System\" or \"Android TV OS build\".
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options → USB/Network Debugging
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Additional Settings → Developer Options → USB Debugging
Settings → System → About → Click \"Android TV OS build\" 7 times → Back → System → Developer Options → Debugging
Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options → USB Debugging
All Settings → Android Settings → Device Preferences → About → Click \"Build\" 7 times → Back → Developer Options
Settings → System → About → Click \"Android TV OS build\" 7 times → Back → System → Developer Options → Network Debugging

YAiPlayer switches off apps on your TV over network debugging (ADB). Nothing is deleted and everything can be switched back, but a TV firmware may behave unexpectedly. The manufacturer may refuse warranty service for problems caused by these changes. You act at your own risk.
On the first connection the TV asks «Allow debugging?». Tick «Always allow from this computer» and press OK.
Only addresses in your home network are allowed.
The TV does not answer. Check the IP address, that network debugging is on and that the phone is on the same Wi-Fi.
The TV did not allow debugging. Press «Connect» again and confirm «Allow» on the TV screen.
Only apps that most lists of this brand switch off.
Only apps that many lists of different brands switch off. The most careful choice.
Choose the model from the list
Switched off by %1$d lists, kept on by %2$d.
Home screen, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and remote, keyboard, TV inputs, Play Store, Google services and the setup wizard stay on.
Restart the TV and check that everything you use works. Anything can be switched back in «Manage and restore».
YAiPlayer has not changed anything on this TV yet.
Save a copy (script for a computer)
Everything is in place, nothing came back.
Found by package name and by how the community lists file each app. This is a hint, not proof.
Recognition of what is on screen (ACR)
Nothing that looks like tracking was found.
Turn off debugging on the TV
Debugging is off. To connect again, turn it on on the TV.
For TV boxes where «Whole TV box» in the remote cannot find the Google remote service.

Installs a light Home screen without ads (the open-source launcher from cleanyourtv) on the TV. Before switching, the TV starts a safety timer: if you do not confirm on the phone, the TV puts its own Home screen back by itself.
Did the new Home screen open on the TV, and does the remote work on it?
Without confirmation the TV restores its own Home screen in %1$d s.
No, bring the old one back
The new Home screen is on. The old launcher can now be ticked in the list.
It did not work. The TV kept its own Home screen.
The old Home screen is back.
Bring back the TV\'s Home screen and remove the new one
This build has no launcher for the TV.
First tick «I understand» below, then the function opens after connecting to the TV.
The TV did not answer. Nothing was changed.
The TV did not accept every change. The old values are kept for undo.
Switch off adverts, tracking and preinstalled apps using 468 community lists. Nothing is deleted.
Install a light ad-free Home screen with a 150-second safety net.
Faster menus: animation scales 0.5 or off, background process limit. Old values come back with one button.
AdGuard DNS on the TV box. Does not remove YouTube adverts.
Find voice, screen recognition (ACR) and telemetry services.
Free memory, processes, idle load and Home screen start time.
Put back one app or everything, script for a computer, check after a firmware update, ADB remote.
«Help add this TV box» and «Report a problem»: text only, without addresses or serial numbers; nothing is sent by itself.
Step by step: switch on network debugging with the remote.
Keep network debugging on at the end
By default it is switched off when you press «Done». It is needed again for undo and the ADB remote.
This TV box: new Home screen and clean-up
This TV box: clean-up (new Home screen at your own risk)
This TV box: clean-up only, a new Home screen is not possible
The model is in the community lists.
The model is not in the lists yet: careful clean-up by brand. «Help add this TV box» helps others.
Chromecast and Google TV Streamer lose casting when the Home screen is replaced.
Fire OS does not keep another Home screen.
Android 7 and older cannot switch the Home screen this way.
TCL China firmware returns its own Home screen.
Your model is not confirmed for the new Home screen. The safety net brings the old one back in 150 seconds if something goes wrong.
Menus open faster when the TV box spends less time on animations. A process limit helps boxes with little memory. Old values are saved first.
2 for boxes with 1–2 GB of memory. Apps in the background may restart more often.
Some TV boxes reset animation speed after a restart: then press «Apply» again.
Private DNS sends the TV box\'s name lookups to AdGuard, which blocks many advert and tracking addresses.

It does not remove YouTube adverts. AdGuard sees which sites the TV box asks for. If your router already filters (Pi-hole, AdGuard Home, VPN with domain lists), Private DNS bypasses it: keep the router instead.
Measure before cleaning and after it. The TV box opens its Home screen for a moment to time it.
Free memory %1$d of %2$d MB · processes %3$d · idle load %4$s · Home screen %5$d ms
The text has no IP addresses, MAC or serial numbers. Nothing is sent: you choose where to share it.
For the new Home screen: 29 themes, your own photos from the phone with a change every few minutes, columns, favourite apps, CPU and memory line.
The choice goes to the TV box and its Home screen restarts. Nothing else on the box changes.
The new Home screen is not installed on this TV box yet: install it first in «New Home screen».
Photos chosen: %1$d of %2$d. Each one is cropped to 16:9, 1280×720, under 300 KB. Your photos replace the theme's pictures.
Tick in the order they should stand. Nothing ticked: the theme's own dock.
Done: the Home screen restarted with the new look.
Did not work: the TV box did not take a file or did not restart Home. Check the connection and try again.
Themes and the Home screen: the Clean Your TV project by Gathin (MIT licence).
